notes.title: Major Demo Update 1.4
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that the new Demo update is finally ready! 🎉
It was made for the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and it's already available for you to play right now!

This is a major update with lots of improvements - so let’s break it down:

[h1]🏙️ New Town[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/3a8f413e11a35cc007aa6847ffbdc528f5ecbabc.png[/img]
The town has received a big visual overhaul!
You’ll now see cars driving and people walking near your shop, making the world feel much more alive.

In the demo, there's only one town available, but expect more towns in the full game!

[h1]📅 Events[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/1e5816196f96e855d0fb8ee96a1fd5b4f023a66a.png[/img]
I've added a new event system that introduces random events occurring between days
Events can last for one or more days and will affect gameplay, bringing both challenges and opportunities for your shop
The idea is to add more variety and dynamism to each playthrough!

📝 Read more in the Dev Diary:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3194690/view/539974986387947710?l=english

[h1]📊 Updated Stats & UI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/d6e47e4ac11c12df6dde131b0ec33322300f425b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/2aa367664947367a788fdc6e5e20a880d87eb321.png[/img]
Pricing and town menus have been improved to make them more informative and user-friendly:
[list]
[*] See the current stock and demand for products
[*] Get insights into town demographics
[*] Filter demographics and shopping lists by clicking on specific groups to see what they want
[/list]

There are also plenty of minor tweaks and bug fixes under the hood - but these are the biggest changes
I hope you enjoy the update, and I'd love to hear your feedback
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Languages
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This update adds support for new languages and includes some minor changes to the game.
[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] German
[/list]

Thanks!

notes.title: Major Demo Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
The new demo update is finally here, and it's a major one! It introduces new gameplay features that make the experience deeper and more interesting.

Let’s break down the core features added:

[h1]Price Regulation[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/75e8c8fb1566e9899c0b68c5e0a4dea53f2f7d50.png[/img]
A new menu allows you to manually adjust prices for each product. Lower prices attract more customers and increase the chance of impulse sales, while higher prices do the opposite
Find the best strategy to optimize your pricing for maximum profit

[h1]Decorations[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/a14bd340263bf0459cf05dee6d788d70597ee7a3.png[/img]
Decorations attract more customers to your shop and increase impulse sales within their range. It's important to place them strategically to cover as many tiles as possible

[h1]Town Generation[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/c6810d963cb8f6d928b447d3f1c3ea32987b44fa.png[/img]
The demo town consists of four customer categories and a population of 300 people. You can randomize the percentage of people in each category, which will directly impact product demand in your shop

[h1]Balance Rework[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/a5514861234782f277ea39e9259705a24e7cbfd2.png[/img]
Customers now have a new parameter called [b]Reach[/b], which represents the likelihood of them visiting your shop when it opens. You can increase this by stocking items on their shopping lists, adding more decorations, and lowering prices.

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Overall UI/UX enhancements
[*] Construction and decoration buttons have been moved to the bottom of the screen
[*] More tooltips for better clarity
[*] Optimized performance for smoother gameplay
[*] You can now fully control the camera while placing objects by holding [b]Shift[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update, Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
The first demo update is live!
This update focuses on improving balance and making the shop economy more engaging to manage. It also includes many minor quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes.

[h3]New expenses[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/d4844fc4d82f8576341b6c292e6a35684496353a.jpg[/img]
Previously, the only expense in the game was restocking products.
Now, you'll also need to pay salaries for cashiers and rent for your acquired shop tiles.
Additionally, I've rebalanced shelf and cash desk prices to account for these new expenses.

[h3]Loans[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221534/3b7118ff51a3b88036dec1ccf3f9331acda04e68.jpg[/img]
Loans have been added to the game! 
If you’re at risk of bankruptcy or want to expand but lack the funds, you can take out a loan and repay it later.
You'll only need to pay daily interest, and you can repay the loan itself whenever you’re ready.

[h3]Bugfixes and improvements[/h3]
Many players reported issues with widescreen resolutions. I’ve worked to address this, and I hope the new version makes the game more comfortable to play. If you still encounter issues, please report them on the Steam Discussions or Discord—thanks!

Here are some of the other quality-of-life improvements and fixes:
- Customers now have more visual variety.
- Cash desk placement now clearly shows its orientation.
- Added a tooltip for quick expansion (hold Shift).
- Objects now start from their initial rotation when you start to move them.
- You can now remove the second entrance and have only one.
- Clearer indication when you don’t have enough money for shelves or cash desks.
- Improved anti-aliasing for UI icons.
And many other minor improvements

Hope you'll enjoy the new update!
